main_body: A red theater seat seen from the front: a backrest panel (rows 2-8) over a seat cushion (rows 10-12), with brown armrests at the sides
top_band: Only a 1-row light pink line at row 2 (x=8, x=11), and 2 rows at x=4 (a lit corner). Nothing reads as a horizontal seat surface
evidence: The column scan at x=8 shows a 1-row light rim at row 2, then a uniform red face (rows 3-8, L=72), a dark line at row 9, and a second red block (rows 10-12, L=72) with a dark base at row 13. The seat cushion is the same tone as the backrest, with no lighter band marking a seat surface seen from above. The seat is a face-on cushion, so it counts as a vertical face. The top is a rim of 1 row, which is too thin to be a surface. This is a front elevation, with no visible seat top.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 7 distinct colours and a median of 7 per tile, against 38-40 colours and 17-20 per tile in the references. It has about 4 red steps (a pink highlight, mid red, dark red and a dark maroon outline). The outline is a tinted dark maroon (0% neutral), so it is not the near-black sticker look. The surfaces are smooth, with no grain, speckle or stitching, so the texture is flat even though no 5x5 block is a single colour. Compared with the richly textured stall and well, the seat looks thinner and simpler.
